newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: China Hope loading 20,718 tonnes soybeans/meal. Iguana loading 29,000 tonnes soybeans/meal. Adalbert Antonov loading 2,000 tonnes soymeal. General Bem loading 31,233 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, six vessels to load soymeal, two for soybeans and one for mixed cargo.
Road: 735 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between June 13 and 15, as well as 1,004 trucks with soymeal and 94 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.
Loading: 23,054 tonnes soybeans, 88,964 tonnes soymeal. Stocks: no figures available.
Vessels: At public terminal, Jin Pu Hai waiting to dock to load 54,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, no vessels docked or waiting to dock.
Road: 68 trucks carrying 1,424 tonnes soybeans arrived on June 15.
Rail: 52 wagons arrived with 2,860 tonnes soybeans.
